events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Bitter Demeanor

options.text: Nod approvingly, and keep on nodding approvingly.
Nod approvingly, and arrange a very inspiring adventure for [character].

events.text: [character] has delivered yet another speech rousing the court to cheers. The puerile atmosphere is, as usual, difficult to stomach. Damn it all. They will expect you to at least nod approvingly, won't they? Is it even possible to keep this veneer up?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Corrupt Conduct

options.text: You want things done your way? Fine, but I expect the unconditional support of house [family].
[character] approval can be revoked...
Kind of you to come by, [character] sends his regards.

events.text: The fury is written on [character] face. "You gave royal assent to [character] depraved schemes? What did he offer you? This must stop, before all of [rival] becomes known as naught but a synonym for depravity and bribery!"

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Cruel Conduct

options.text: Perhaps I was somewhat... harsh. How hard could a little diplomatic moderation be?
Ah, thank you, a good reminder. Guards, see that the prisoners' stomachs are not spared.

events.text: One day on a stroll around the palace, [character] rounds on you. "Do you really call that justice? Those prisoners... I do not care what treason they might have done, they do not deserve that fate. Is a trace of compassion so hard to stomach?"

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Deceitful Conduct

options.text: Let the pause linger, and finally grant [character] a somber nod.
Let the pause linger, and finally grant the poor dolt a somber nod.

events.text: You stare down [character] and insist, "I said nothing of the kind! You must have misheard, but no matter, it should not pose a problem, should it?" [character] takes on a grim look. "I shall not forsake you or [rival], but I beg of you, be more careful with your words, or others shall not choose the same."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Extravagant Conduct

options.text: Sigh deeply. "So be it, for beloved [rival], we will find some... boldly austere alternatives."
Nod curtly, "Then I shall not be expecting to see you at the feast. Or in [rival] at all."

events.text: You point at the next platter "And these! Do you know how much ice it takes to bring one of these fresh from the north? It's a wonder to watch them tugging around the blocks with their little ropes." [character] visibly blanches as you run through the next course's origins before he finally works up the courage to speak. "Please, my [title], I beg of you, can we reserve some of the royal treasury to insure against war and poor harvests? This... I do not see how this can continue."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Foolish Conduct

options.text: Never stop an enemy from overestimating your misunderestimation!
Maybe my ideas could use a bit more... refinement.

events.text: [character] is looking at you aghast. "...you said what about our military to [character]?! He is not one to overlook the hint of weakness. [rival] legions will be gathering on the frontiers as we speak..." [character] presses you, for the good of [rival]: let him try and salvage the [rival] situation and take a leading role in [rival] government.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Intolerant Conduct

options.text: Think on the conversation throughout the day.
Narrow your eyes. "What drivel are you spouting now? Some kind of weak-minded [tribe] notions? Didn't your uncle marry one of those man-beasts?"

events.text: You scoff, "[character]? He can hardly be trusted with so much as showing up on time. Lazy [rival]." [character] stares at you hard at this and finally says, "Is it so hard for you to give anyone the benefit of the doubt? That there might be slightly more to people than your preconceptions?"

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Slothful Conduct

options.text: Sigh deeply. "The travel alone... but, fine, so it shall be."
"Surely the people know the wisest leaders conserve their strength!"

events.text: [character] pounds the table. "We are losing this war as you sit here in this damned palace! Show the people you can lead, or all is lost."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Superstitious Demeanor

options.text: Take a deep breath. "We can try... but I cannot help but feel we flirt with disaster."
We do not trifle with the heavens.

events.text: The veins bulge on [character]'s forehead as he maintains a carefully controlled tone. "My [title], perhaps the stars do indicate this will be a difficult year, but we cannot afford to delay all of the decisions demanded across [rival]!"

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Timid Demeanor

options.text: Let the pause linger, then, "...what am I going to do about it? Me? Nothing, no, it's my armies you need to worry about."
Abruptly call a break for refreshments.

events.text: [character] leans forward across the negotiation table. "So, little man, what are you going to do about it?" He leans back, smirking in the long pause as you search for words. "That's what I thought."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Uncouth Conduct

options.text: Sigh deeply. "Right, budget shortfalls, crop yields, how's the family, you got it."
Slap him firmly on the back. "Right, we've got this. Every hole in that budget's gonna be filled like a cheap [rival]."

events.text: You smile wider, "... and that's when the groom looks around, confused, and asks 'but why is his ass f-'" [character] cuts you off abruptly with a truly raucous bout of coughing and takes you aside from the negotiation table. "Perhaps it is best to save such tales for less... formal contexts, my [title]?" He looks pleading.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Wanton Conduct

options.text: Can you not see we are in the middle of something, [character]?
Sigh deeply. "Perhaps... I can try it your way."
No problem. One perk of [character] being head of [religion] is he can simply declare us married.

events.text: You can almost hear the grinding of [character] teeth as he speaks. "It is simply not... befitting, the way [character] and you carry on! The heavens demand a certain decorum and restraint from mortals. Please, I beg of you, weigh the costs of these earthly desires more carefully!"
